history.summary: A freehold 646 sqft 1BR at $1.14M in D15 East Coast, 450m to Tanjong Katong MRT (TEL). Resale-only 6.7%/yr CAGR and a $1,762 PSF ~16% under the $2,096 URA median look strong, but the rate rests on just 14 transactions, which is statistically thin.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely attractive surface: freehold, deep D15 buyer pool, 450m to a now-operational TEL station, low $1.14M quantum, and PSF ~16% below URA median $2,096. The catch is reliability — the 6.7% resale CAGR sits on only 14 URA transactions, well below the 30+ threshold for confidence, so the appreciation number is noisy and could mean-revert. A larger 646 sqft 1BR is on the bigger side for the type. Good location and entry price, but I won't rate Buy on a 14-txn rate; treat the discount-to-median as the real signal.

history.summary: Freehold 2014 SOHO 1BR (3.35m ceilings) at 25 Amber Road, D15. Near the new Amber & Marine Parade TEL MRT stations (genuine catalyst). Asking $1,761 PSF sits at the low end of the project's $1,160K-$1,860K range. BUT the algo's cheap signals (-16% cohort, -17.8% age-adj) rest on psf_cohort_txns=1 and appreciation_txns=14 — too thin to verify as a real bargain.
history.rating_rationale: The story is attractive: freehold, distinctive high-ceiling SOHO format, and the Thomson-East Coast Line (Amber/Marine Parade stations) is a real, recently-realized connectivity catalyst in a prime D15 (RCR) belt. However, I could not verify the algo's cheapness against actual recent 1BR transactions — the cohort signal is built on a single comparable and only 14 appreciation transactions, and the 76-unit project is too small for reliable price discovery or exit liquidity. Per v3.4 priors, a big negative premium on 1-2 comparables is likely a data quirk, and freehold is not itself a forward edge. The catalyst keeps it out of Avoid, but thin data caps this at a low-confidence Neutral.
